value.body: LPO associates do legal support work that law firms and companies outsource: contract review, litigation document review, research and drafting support. Legal process outsourcing companies and in-house legal operations centres hire them, many serving overseas clients. The day is spent reviewing documents on screen against instructions and quality checks.

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Document review platforms, contract management systems, legal databases

items.note: All years. Counts only institutions that responded to AISHE, so national totals may be higher.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers join through campus or open hiring and are trained in the client's laws and review protocols. Strong English reading and writing are tested; enrolment with a Bar Council is not usually required for the role itself.

value.title: At a glance
items: Work for overseas clients can follow their time zones.
Next steps: senior associate, team lead, or a move to in-house legal.
The role builds contract skills but not courtroom experience.
